messages:
zain: Quick share 9 noticed a config sweep this morning that caused transient route thrash. small tenant, but many flags toggled.

zain: ```
[2026-03-23T11:10:01Z] config-apply: id=CFG-910 user=monica scope=tenant:99 flags=48
[2026-03-23T11:10:02Z] router: inflight=412 capacity=500 queue_depth=380
[2026-03-23T11:10:03Z] orchestrator: partial_success=18 paused=1 reason=auto_pause_high_load
```

monica: we ran preview but didn't include route-density in estimator. that was the blindspot.

ralph: proposal: add an "entropy" heuristic to the estimator that scores how many distinct route targets a scope touches. high entropy => lower default parallelism.

kevin: +1. estimator API: POST /v1/apply/estimate {scope,parallelism} -> {peak,pool_risk,entropy_score,suggested_parallelism}. make entropy_score a percentile string like "p90" so owners get intuitive signal.

ops-bot: incident: router-pool spike detected (incident-2026-03-23-004).

monica: UX: show entropy pill next to risk; offer "auto-adjust for entropy" toggle that reduces parallelism heuristically and suggests batching.

zain: runtime: implement token-bucket per pool and an apply-coordinator that will respect entropy-aware suggested_parallelism unless override=true AND user is admin. log audit for overrides.

ralph: telemetry: emit apply.preflight.entropy, apply.preflight.peak, apply.fanout.inflight_by_pool. also surface in console preview graphs.

kevin: timeline: I can add entropy calc to estimator and telemetry in 3 days. monica will wire UI change in 5 days. ralph will add gating logic in 4 days.

monica: action items:
- kevin: estimator entropy + metrics (due 2026-03-26)
- ralph: coordinator gating + audit hooks (due 2026-03-27)
- monica: console pill + auto-adjust flow (due 2026-03-28)
- zain: runbook update + incident link (due 2026-03-28)

zain: thanks team. creating ticket CFG-912 and linking incident. leaving thread open for updates. :eyes:
